title: The Loose button on the coat
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：loose　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 loose 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the musician wrote of ① a loose button on the coat in the programme, and everybody in the hall said at once that it was ② looser than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the musician, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the loose ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the loosest button on the coat anybody in the hall had ever seen, or so the programme for December 1956 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too loose to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the loose ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a loose talk at the meeting, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as loose as the talk at the meeting they had once had in the old hall. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was loose or not, and he said so.

By 1969 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something loose, and nothing besides. The listener from the next hall called the whole plan ⑧ quite loose; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the loose ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1972, without complaint, she wrote of another loose button on the coat in the same programme, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ looser than anybody had expected. ⑩ The loosest talk at the meeting in the whole hall, she said in 1974, was the one she could never quite name; the loose ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 松动（前置定语 a loose button on the coat：1962 年乐师在节目单里记下的那件松动的扣子）
B. adj. 松动／散漫（比较级 looser than：文中两处，一处比外套上松动的扣子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 松动／散漫（最高级 the loosest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 松动（表语 too loose to do：母亲觉得它太松动，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 散漫（前置定语 a loose talk at the meeting：叔叔把整件事称作一桩散漫的发言）
F. adj. 散漫（同级比较 as loose as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩会上散漫的发言相比）
G. adj. 散漫（后置定语 something loose：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 散漫（受程度副词修饰 quite loose：那位听客的评价）

items.q: a loose button on the coat
the loosest button on the coat anybody
a loose talk at the meeting
The loosest talk at the meeting in

answers.why: loose 意为“松动”，1962 年乐师在节目单里记下的是“一件松动的扣子”，此处作前置定语 a loose button on the coat。
loose 意为“松动”，此处用比较级 looser than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
loose 意为“松动”，节目单上 十二月 那行字说它是音乐厅里最松动的一件，故用最高级 the loosest button on the coat。
loose 意为“松动”，母亲认为这件东西“太松动了，谁也用不上”，too loose to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
loose 意为“散漫”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩散漫的发言”，此处作前置定语 a loose talk at the meeting。
loose 意为“散漫”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩会上散漫的发言一样散漫”，同级比较用 as loose as。
loose 意为“散漫”，节目单上那半行字要的是“散漫的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something loose。
loose 意为“散漫”，邻音乐厅来的那位听客认为这套计划“相当散漫”，quite 修饰原级 loose。
loose 意为“散漫”，1972 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要散漫”，故用比较级 looser than。
loose 意为“散漫”，母亲 1974 年说的是“整个音乐厅里最散漫的那一桩”，故用最高级 the loosest talk at the meeting。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1962 年，乐师在节目单里记下了一件松动的扣子。（a loose button on the coat）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更松动。（looser than …）
母亲觉得它太松动，谁也用不上。（too loose to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩散漫的发言。（a loose talk at the meeting）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩会上散漫的发言一样散漫。（as loose as …）
到了 1969 年，节目单上只剩半行字：要的是一件散漫的东西。（something loose）
answers: In 1962 the musician wrote of a loose button on the coat in the programme.
Everybody said it was looser than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too loose to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a loose talk at the meeting.
He said nobody would call it as loose as the talk at the meeting they had once had.
By 1969 the programme asked for nothing but something loose.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 loose 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1962 the musician wrote of a loose button on the coat in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the loosest button on the coat in the hall, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too loose to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a loose talk at the meeting, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next hall called the plan quite loose, and everybody laughed.
The loose ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
